requirement.evidence: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction. Note that the mere expiration of a rental agreement or a change in ownership does not constitute "just cause" for eviction.
requirement.note: Housing services point also stated: landlord needs just cause to remove access to garage, parking, storage, laundry. Change in ownership is not exactly 'building being sold', but close enough.
